events.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, time
from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats
counts=pd.read_csv('inputs/counts_raw_unfiltered.csv',index_col=0)
cols=['3_1','3_2','3_3','9_1','9_2','9_3']
x=counts[cols].T
meta=pd.DataFrame({'condition':['DMSO']*3+['CBD_cisplatin']*3},index=cols)
print('input',x.shape,'nonzero genes',(x.sum(axis=0)>0).sum(),flush=True)
t=time.time()
dds=DeseqDataSet(counts=x,metadata=meta,design='~condition',refit_cooks=True,n_cpus=2,quiet=False)
dds.deseq2()
print('fit secs',time.time()-t,flush=True)
st=DeseqStats(dds,contrast=['condition','CBD_cisplatin','DMSO'],alpha=0.05,n_cpus=2,quiet=False)
st.summary()
r=st.results_df
print('results',r.shape,'padj nonnull',r.padj.notna().sum())
deg=r[(r.padj<0.05)&(r.log2FoldChange.abs()>=0.5)]
print('DEG',len(deg),'up',(deg.log2FoldChange>0).sum(),'down',(deg.log2FoldChange<0).sum())
print(deg.sort_values('padj').head(20).to_string())
# just calculate target mapping hits after downloading lib
import gseapy as gp
ann=pd.read_csv('inputs/ensg_to_gene_name.tsv',sep='\\t').set_index('ENSG')['gene_name']
genes=ann.reindex(deg.index).dropna().tolist()
print('mapped rows',len(genes),'unique symbols',len(set(genes)))
lib=gp.get_library(name='Reactome_2022',organism='Human')
term='TP53 Regulates Transcription Of Cell Cycle Genes'
print('library terms',len(lib),'target exact',term in lib)
if term in lib:
 pgenes=lib[term]
 hits=sorted(set(genes)&set(pgenes))
 print('target pathway size',len(pgenes),'hits',len(hits),hits)
# exact enrichr online
res=gp.enrichr(gene_list=genes,gene_sets='Reactome_2022',organism='human',outdir=None,verbose=True)
row=res.results[res.results.Term.eq(term)]
print(row.to_string(index=False))
PY"

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, time, gseapy as gp
from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats
counts=pd.read_csv('inputs/counts_raw_unfiltered.csv',index_col=0)
ann=pd.read_csv('inputs/ensg_to_gene_name.tsv',sep='\\t').set_index('ENSG')['gene_name']
lib=gp.get_library(name='Reactome_2022',organism='Human')
term=[k for k in lib if k.startswith('TP53 Regulates Transcription Of Cell Cycle Genes ')][0]
path=set(lib[term])
print('TERM',term,'SIZE',len(lib[term]),'UNIQUE',len(path),'GENES',sorted(path),flush=True)

def run(label, cols, groups):
 x=counts[cols].T
 meta=pd.DataFrame({'condition':groups},index=cols)
 print('\\nRUN',label,x.shape,meta.condition.value_counts().to_dict(),flush=True)
 dds=DeseqDataSet(counts=x,metadata=meta,design='~condition',refit_cooks=True,n_cpus=2,quiet=True)
 dds.deseq2()
 st=DeseqStats(dds,contrast=['condition','Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50','DMSO'],alpha=0.05,n_cpus=2,quiet=True)
 st.summary()
 r=st.results_df
 deg=r[(r.padj<0.05)&(r.log2FoldChange.abs()>=0.5)]
 syms=ann.reindex(deg.index).dropna()
 hits=sorted(set(syms)&path)
 print('DEG',len(deg),'MAPPED',len(syms),'UNIQUE',syms.nunique(),'HITS',len(hits),'OVERLAP',f'{len(hits)}/{len(path)}','HITGENES',hits,flush=True)
 print('hit details')
 rr=r.join(ann.rename('symbol'))
 print(rr[rr.symbol.isin(path)].sort_values('padj').head(60).to_string(),flush=True)
 return deg
cols6=['3_1','3_2','3_3','9_1','9_2','9_3']
g6=['DMSO']*3+['Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50']*3
run('subset6',cols6,g6)
# All 30 samples, group labels matched from metadata
layout=pd.read_csv('inputs/sample_layout.csv')
layout['col']=layout.SampleID.str.replace('-','_',regex=False)
run('all30',layout['col'].tolist(),layout.Group.tolist())
PY"
